pos: The person remains standing in the exact center of the frame for the whole shot, looking exactly as in the reference frames: same face, same hairstyle, same clothing, same body shape. Feet planted on the ground, head level and still, with a barely perceptible, gentle breathing motion in the chest and shoulders. The facial expression is a calm, neutral, relaxed look that never changes: mouth softly closed, no smile, brows relaxed, eyes open and steady, looking directly at the camera. The camera is locked on a fixed tripod at a constant distance from the person: the distance never changes, the framing never changes, and the person's apparent size stays exactly the same from the first frame to the last, with no zoom-in, no zoom-out, no push-in, no pull-out, no dolly and no drift of any kind. The background is completely static and rock-steady: every wall, door, floor tile and object stays locked in its exact position with zero movement, zero wobble, zero shimmer and zero flicker for the entire shot, exactly matching the reference frames. The mouth stays completely closed for the entire shot: lips gently pressed together, jaw relaxed and motionless, teeth and tongue never visible. The person does not talk, does not speak, does not laugh out loud, does not yawn and never opens the mouth at any point; this is a silent, wordless pose transition only. The background stays exactly as in the reference frames: each element holding the same position, shape and brightness throughout, with no new objects and no environment changes. The lighting, brightness and colors match the reference frames exactly. The camera is locked off on a tripod: it holds the same angle, position and framing for the entire duration, with no pan, no zoom, no shake and no drift, keeping the person at exactly the same apparent size and distance. The only other movement is the smooth, gradual ease into the exact pose of the final reference frame. The movement between the two poses is kept to the absolute minimum: slow, small, subtle and barely perceptible, with no gestures, no head turning, no hand raising, no stepping and no weight shifting beyond what the two reference poses strictly require. The facial expression stays frozen and identical in every frame: the same neutral calm face, unchanged brows, unchanged eyes and unchanged mouth shape throughout. Between movements the person simply breathes gently, otherwise remaining nearly still.

_comment: 2026-11-04 近乎静止版（用户拍板：过渡段表情动作几乎不动）：基于 neutral 配方，guide 0.85→0.92（首尾帧主导）、stg_scale 1.1→0.7（压运动）、cfg 2.5→2.2（降提示驱动），pos 加最小运动+表情冻结段。依据 STG 论文与 Lightricks 官方博客（stg_scale 越高运动越多）。运动量需过 motion 度量门（中位帧间差、帧间差总和 vs 上一轮）。
